envelope.command: gh repo edit five exact repositories --visibility private --accept-visibility-change-consequences; disable GitHub Actions for all six active repositories; verify exact repository identity, visibility, default branch, archival state, Actions permissions, and workflow inventory

failed_outcomes.name: github_managed_dependency_graph_disable
failed_outcomes.observed: GitHub retained a read-only dynamic/dependabot/update-graph entry for Engine after public-to-private conversion. The workflow disable API returned HTTP 422 because the entry is platform-managed, and the repository security-analysis PATCH does not expose dependency-graph control. No repository workflow file, test runner, build, deployment, release, or user-authored Actions workflow exists.

user_approval.source: explicit Codex task request on 2026-08-05 to apply the revised Numerical Verification-Driven Development policy project-wide, remove CI/CD, and change repositories to private where needed

observations.name: private_visibility
observations.expected: All six active repositories report private visibility.
observations.observed: Governance, organization metadata, Engine, Validation, Data, and Lab all report private visibility with their preflight repository IDs unchanged.

observations.name: repository_identity
observations.expected: Names, repository IDs, default branches, archival state, and local remotes remain unchanged.
observations.observed: All six exact repositories remain unarchived on main, and every local origin points to its canonical private repository name.

observations.name: ci_cd_absent
observations.expected: No active repository owns CI/CD or repository-authored Actions workflows, and GitHub Actions execution is disabled.
observations.observed: GitHub Actions is disabled for all six repositories. No active checkout or remote main contains .github/workflows, and GitHub reports no user-authored workflow; Engine alone exposes a non-executable GitHub-managed read-only dependency-graph analysis entry.

observations.name: nvdd_authority
observations.expected: Governance revision 10 makes local Numerical Verification-Driven Development the canonical verification policy.
observations.observed: D-025 and the live repository instructions bind numerical scientific evidence to local repository environments and explicitly exclude CI/CD and compatibility-contract testing.

preconditions: The exact repository IDs, names, default branches, visibility, and workflow inventory matched the authorization preflight.
The user explicitly authorized private visibility and CI/CD removal.
Lab was already private and required no external mutation.
expected_postconditions: All six active repositories remain private.
GitHub Actions remains disabled and no active repository owns a CI/CD workflow, deployment, release automation, or test matrix.
Local Codex environments and repository scripts remain the only project verification runners.
Any GitHub-managed dependency analysis is classified separately from project CI/CD.
record.retry: No visibility retry is pending. Any future visibility or platform-analysis change requires a new exact operation record.
stop_conditions: An active repository becomes public without a separately approved doctrine change.
A repository-authored Actions workflow, deployment, or release automation is introduced.
A repository ID, canonical name, or default branch diverges from the completed state.
record.reversibility: Repository visibility can be changed through a separately authorized GitHub settings operation; Git history and repository IDs remain unchanged.
irreversible_effects: GitHub may erase public stars and detach public forks as a consequence of public-to-private conversion.
